name: Prompt Composer
title: Prompt Composer
description: A Tailwind prompt field with a sculpted arc of tinted action cards, a shared model-menu highlight and coordinated GSAP springs.
summary: Five numbered, individually illustrated cards form a balanced arc above the field. Lavender image collages, taped notes, a mint calendar, coral waveforms and blue document stacks respond together on hover or keyboard focus. The model menu opens on pointer hover, pins on click and moves one rounded highlight between choices. Supports async submissions, retained failed drafts, custom models and actions, optional audio transcription, both themes and reduced motion. Inspired by Pin UI, with an original card treatment and composition.
highlights: Tailwind v4 utilities and scoped CSS variables; no component stylesheet
A five-color card arc with original miniature illustrations and coordinated spring motion
Profile-style shared model-menu hover highlight, pointer opening and click pinning
Configurable width, radius, accent, hover lift, neighbour spread and speed
Controlled or uncontrolled input, custom action labels and custom model IDs
Async sends lock duplicate submissions and preserve failed drafts
Optional real microphone capture with an application-provided transcription callback
Explicit demo voice for previews, with no microphone access
Container queries, both themes, keyboard model navigation and reduced-motion support
anatomy: Removable action chip and labelled input
Recorder with waveform, timer, cancellation and transcription state

physics.description: One scoped timeline coordinates the fan and card illustrations. Transforms begin at current values, with a short stagger on reveal. Recorder tickers, media tracks, requests and animations are cleaned up on unmount.

accessibility.aria: Labelled form and input, inert hidden cards and menus, menu radio choices, expanded tray state, pending submission state, voice status announcements and retryable alerts. Focus returns to the input after removing an action or finishing voice capture.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Card transforms and content changes settle immediately; the recording waveform stays static and spinners do not rotate.

keyboard.description: Move through the model picker, visible cards and field controls.
Activate a card, toggle a tray or model menu, or submit the field.
Close the model menu, cancel voice capture or remove the selected action.
Remove the selected action when the field is empty.

recommended: Document question and image prompt interfaces
bestPractices: Connect onSend to your application and resolve only after the prompt is accepted. Rejection retains the draft.
Use stable unique model IDs. The submission model value is the model ID, not its display name.
Cards express prompt intent; image generation, events and document upload are handled by your application.
Voice is disabled unless onTranscribe or demoVoice is provided. Demo mode must stay explicit in user-facing previews.
Real recording requires HTTPS or localhost and browser microphone permission. Send the audio Blob through your server, honor AbortSignal and keep credentials out of the browser.
A transcription callback takes precedence over demoVoice. Cancel and unmount stop microphone tracks and abort transcription.
Provide onValueChange whenever value is controlled. Theme system follows the host dark class.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled value or initial uncontrolled draft.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives edits, transcript insertion and successful clearing.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Receives trimmed text, action ID or null, and model ID. Reject to retain the draft and show errorMessage.

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to five unique built-in action IDs with custom labels and placeholders; an empty array removes the cards.

props.name: models
props.description: Model IDs, names and optional descriptions. An empty list disables submission.

props.name: defaultModel / onModelChange
props.description: Initial model ID and selection callback. Removed selections fall back to the first model.

props.name: placeholder / label
props.description: Default visual placeholder and accessible input label.

props.name: theme
props.description: Inherit the host theme or explicitly select a palette.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width in pixels, bounded to 280–1200. The component always fits its container.

props.name: radius
props.description: Field radius in pixels, bounded to 10–28.

props.name: cardLift / cardSpread
props.description: Hover lift and neighbour offset in pixels, bounded to 0–32 and 0–20.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier, bounded to 0.5–2.

props.name: stiffness / damping
props.description: Shared physical spring settings for the card fan, illustrations and model-menu highlight. Stiffness is bounded to 120–600 and damping to 18–60.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: CSS color used for the send control, action glyphs and focus indicators.

props.name: defaultTrayOpen
props.description: Whether the action cards start open.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable editing and actions; active recording is cancelled.

props.name: onTranscribe
props.description: Enables real microphone recording. Return the transcript or reject for a safe retryable error.

props.name: demoVoice
props.description: Enable a simulated recorder and sample transcript when onTranscribe is absent. Never accesses the microphone.

props.name: errorMessage
props.defaultValue: Could not send your message. Please try again.
props.description: Safe error text shown when onSend rejects.

props.name: className / style / ref
props.description: Root styling and forwarded root ref.
